title: Resolution urging Albany to toughen penalties for assaults on school staff
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation making certain assaults against school principals, administrators, supervisors and other pedagogical staff a felony. It also urges stronger protections against threats, harassment and intimidation directed at such staff and their immediate family members, including incidents occurring off school grounds. It cites existing Penal Law provisions covering assaults on school grounds as insufficient to address threats made elsewhere.
